Lesson goal

Move from leaving the ground to a controlled, repeatable jump, and understand how feature shape, speed, trajectory and rider movement interact.

What it will cover

  • Jump vocabulary and feature geometry
  • Performance intents: boost, carry speed, absorb, scrub, style, clear a gap
  • Rider–bike relationship through approach, takeoff, flight and landing
  • Video from side, front and landing angles
  • Repeatability: one variable at a time under coach guidance
  • Casing, overshooting and loss of control

Physics & maths

Projectile motion: the same takeoff speed and angle give the same flight, which is why consistency starts at the approach. Ties directly to Jump Lab and the MTB Physics Playground.

Safety

Class 2: advanced riding skills. Needs the stated prerequisites, a controlled progression, suitable terrain and coaching guidance.

Practice only on terrain your coach has chosen, within your current skill, with the right protective equipment. Completing a lesson isn’t a safety certificate and doesn’t mean a rider is ready to try anything.
